In this section we conducted the analysis of population strucure. The population used was a combined population of all the genotype included in the GWAS analysis for resistance against A. pisum and A. fabae.

The R script contain the script for creation of all the part of the final figure used in the publication.

The kinship used in this section was created using the software GEMMA 0.98.5 (2021-08-25) by Xiang Zhou, Pjotr Prins and team (C) 2012-2021 with the option `-gk 1` → centered

Admixture was generated using ADMIXTURE Version 1.3.0 Copyright 2008-2015 David Alexander, Suyash Shringarpure, John Novembre, Ken Lange
